name: 検索付きの通話の音選択シート
prompt: Correct attempt a001 after visual review: the generated draft enlarged the title and cards and shifted the lower people icon from the native geometry. Build the final 390×740 candidate from the exact native 390×740 preview, preserving every Japanese character, placement, card position, layout, and people icon. Remove the mint card fills, make the search surface neutral gray #F1F1F1, and use neutral gray #E0E0E0 for the unselected card borders; keep the selected first-card outline #047857. Use the six original embedded PNG assets from the .figcraft file, unmodified, at their original 32×38 frames: duck, airhorn, cricket, clapping hands, gold horn, drum. No link text is present. No tint fills, gradients, shadows, added labels, or branding.
reviewNotes: ネイティブ390×740の配置・日本語内容を保持し、埋め込み元PNG6点を32×38の元フレームに使用。カード面は白、検索面は中立グレー、非選択枠は中立グレー、選択枠と人物アイコンのみブランド緑。ミントの色付き面はなく、リンク文字もない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
